note: The shot list: authored camera direction per beat. size is wide (the whole set), group (everyone on stage), two (Odie and the person named in on), single (one person, waist up) or close (one face). on names who the shot holds; 'speaker' means whoever is talking. An authored shot cuts in; "cut": false drifts instead. Beats not listed keep the automatic camera (Odie and whoever speaks). why is the director's note, for the Lab and for critics.
